title: GitLab - Brute-force Attempts
description: Identifies brute-force attempts against GitLab accounts.

steps.question: Does the row match what the rule looks for?
steps.why: Identifies brute-force attempts against GitLab accounts.

steps.question: Every sign-in from the source address in the last day
steps.why: A password spray shows as many accounts from one address.

steps.question: Is the address on the corporate VPN egress list?
steps.why: The VPN egress is the usual benign case: one address, many users.

steps.question: Hold the account, or mark the address benign?

benign_when.text: The source is a corporate VPN egress address.
The account is a load-test service account during a scheduled run.

escalate_when.text: Any success after the failures from the same address.

notes: Ask the platform team for the egress list before holding anything.
